_description: Base Azure SRE Agent for the onboarding lab. Creates the agent, read-only Azure access, app telemetry, Azure Monitor incident platform, and ticketing app source context. Workflow extensions are installed separately.
_prerequisites: Application Insights resource and application IDs from the azd environment

resourceGroup.ask: Resource group created by the onboarding workload deployment

appInsightsId.ask: Ticket reservation Application Insights resource ID

appInsightsAppId.ask: Ticket reservation Application Insights application ID

githubRepo.ask: Attendee GitHub repository URL for the self-contained ticketing app project
